spec_match.rationale: Uses the real SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel definition: int-enum 0/1/2, can_be_recommended, per_profile. The validator enforces the schema {type: integer, enum: [0,1,2]}.

interactive.rationale: Level, enforcement and platform radios regenerate the snippet and effect text; a Copy button uses the real Clipboard API; the JSON validator parses pasted input.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card describes exactly what the page does, including that it is a labelled model / manual observation where applicable.

edge_cases.rationale: Validator catches non-JSON, a non-object top level, string values, out-of-range values, case-mismatched names, an unset policy, and the deprecated SafeBrowsingEnabled policy.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5094379441225728 plus the Chromium source or blog sources used.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's manual assertions (ESB gating, data minimisation, model swap) point at this page as the observation route and are honestly reported as blocked; no fake probe.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 (Playwright CDP) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch. chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so there is no DevTools-MCP verification and no accessibility-tree dump. All 4 platforms, both modes and all 3 levels were exercised. Copy reported 'Copied'. Validator verdicts: '"2"' gave a type error; the lowercase key gave a case-sensitivity hint; 3 was out of the enum; '{bad' gave a parse error; the generated JSON was valid. Only the 2 expected panel warnings appeared.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts snippet generation, copy success or fallback, and validator runs, with no policy contents or user input in the payloads.

design_system.rationale: Only public/styles.css tokens; buttons that override background also set color; status colours (emerald-dark, rose) used only on light backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, fieldset/legend, polite live regions and visible focus. However, the accessibility tree was not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Exercised at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both after the final edit, single-column layout on mobile, 44px targets.

openQuestions.title: Verify macOS recommended-policy guidance and the Admin console path
openQuestions.detail: The macOS 'recommended' wording points to MDM Set-Once preferences generically, and the Admin console path (Users & browsers > Security > Safe Browsing protection) is written from memory of the console layout. Verify both against current Chrome Enterprise docs.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard status updates, reserve assertive for critical ones; label every control; visible focus; 24px+ targets (bumped to 44px here).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Readouts and verdicts are aria-live polite (never assertive); all inputs are inside <label>; :focus-visible 3px outline; buttons/labels min-height 44px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use visible radio buttons for 1-5 exclusive options, native checkboxes for multi-select, label every input, use aria-describedby for hints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All exclusive choices (level, mode, platform, pipeline) are native radio groups in fieldset/legend; hints linked with aria-describedby.
All dynamic output is built with textContent and createElement; no innerHTML anywhere, including the user-pasted JSON in the validator.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Defer validation feedback until the user commits a value.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The JSON validator runs only on an explicit Validate click, never while typing.

summary: Practical admin tool: real snippet generator and schema validator for the one policy that controls enrollment.
